title: Find the Winner of an Array Game
summary: Given an array of distinct integers and an integer k, compare the first two elements.
statement: Given an array of distinct integers and an integer k, compare the first two elements. The larger element stays at the start, and the smaller moves to the end. Continue this process until one element wins k consecutive rounds. Return the winning element.
constraints: arr contains distinct integers; the larger of the first two wins a round and stays in front while the loser moves to the end.
Return the first value to win k consecutive rounds.
reference_solution:
def array_game_winner(arr, k):
 champion=arr[0];wins=0
 for rival in arr[1:]:
  if champion>rival:wins+=1
  else:champion=rival;wins=1
  if wins==k:return champion
 return champion

hints: Keep the current front champion and its consecutive wins.
Compare it with each new challenger in original order; the larger becomes champion.
A new champion has already won once, while a surviving champion increments its streak.
Once the global maximum arrives it never loses, so a single pass suffices even when k is large.
